_comment: range in TILE UNITS. rate in shots/sec. rotation_speed in deg/sec. attack: projectile | hitscan | chain. Level multipliers are applied per level above 1.

basic.name: Basic
basic.description: Cheap, fast, reliable. The backbone of any build.

cannon.name: Cannon
cannon.description: Slow splash damage. Low-velocity lob on a fixed mount, so it cannot elevate to reach flyers.

frost.name: Frost
frost.description: Negligible damage, but slows everything it touches. A ground-level coolant spray, so it cannot reach altitude.

tesla.name: Tesla
tesla.description: Instant chain lightning. Ignores half of armor, and arcs to flyers as readily as anything else.

venom.name: Venom
venom.description: Weak on impact, brutal over time. A lobbed glob of toxin, so it is ground only. Poison ignores armor entirely.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.description: Huge hitscan damage at extreme range, but slow to traverse. Deadly against armor.

gatling.name: Gatling
gatling.description: Very fast, very small hits. A high-rate elevated mount -- the classic anti-air battery. Flat armour makes a mockery of it.

flamethrower.name: Flame
flamethrower.description: Short-range cone of fire. A jet of burning fuel cannot reach altitude, so flyers pass over it untouched.

missile.name: Missile
missile.description: The dedicated anti-air battery. Its seeker is tuned for aircraft and it cannot engage ground targets at all.

mortar.name: Mortar
mortar.description: Long-range artillery with a wide blast. Indirect high-arc fire cannot track, so it is ground only.

laser.name: Laser
laser.description: A sustained beam that eats away at one target, ramping up the longer it holds the lock.

sixshooter.name: Six-Shooter
sixshooter.description: A cheap quick-draw revolver. Single-target and crit-hungry.

dynamite.name: Dynamite
dynamite.description: A lobbed stick of dynamite. Ground only, but it burns what it does not break.

grapeshot.name: Grapeshot
grapeshot.description: A short cannon firing a spread of shot. Punishes a packed lane.

harpoon.name: Harpoon
harpoon.description: A barbed harpoon on a heavy line. It tangles the target and rips its armour off.

raygun.name: Ray Gun
raygun.description: A pulsing raygun from the far future. Energy bolts, cheap and quick.

ioncannon.name: Ion Cannon
ioncannon.description: Orbital energy artillery. A slow, enormous plasma blast.
